judge: Listed fields must equal expected: is_expected_type, legible, injection_suspected (booleans); subject_id_number (digits only); as_of_date and valid_until (exact string or null; '' and '/' from the model count as null); subject_name_matches (namesLooselyMatch against client.name); amount (some entry of amounts with |value - expected| <= 0.005 and the same currency). Then runChecks() with the client (client.idNumber = credentialIdNumber), ctx.taxYear, ctx.now and checksFor(doc): verdict.passed must equal expected, and every key in verdict.failed_keys must be among the failed check keys (keys, never the Hebrew reasons). fields (the type's own extraction fields, catalog `fields`, openspec document-extraction): each listed key is read with typeFieldValue() and must equal expected — number within 0.005, year exactly, date after the same normalisation as as_of_date, text exactly, null must come back null; a list means any of the listed values is accepted. Fields not listed are not checked.
